briefdescription.para: Model horizontal reductions.

detaileddescription.para: A horizontal reduction is a tree of reduction instructions that has values that can be put into a vector as its leaves. For example:

mul mul mul mul \ / \ /
+ \ /
This tree has "mul" as its leaf values and "+" as its reduction instructions. A reduction can feed into a store or a binary operation feeding a phi. ... \ /
